_doc: THIRD PASS — the Next-COMMITTED walk of the guided online N-400. Draft 13370795, 2026-07-30. Answers were seeded with safe junk and COMMITTED with Next, which is the only way myUSCIS persists them and therefore the only way conditional PAGES appear. Companion to n400-online-field-dump.json (unconditional shape) and n400-online-reveals.json (in-page reveals + repeater rows). Nothing was ever Submitted, Signed or Paid; Next is refused on any /review-and-submit/* path.
HEADLINE: The page count is not 37. It grows from 37 to 49 as answers are committed, and almost all of the growth is /evidence/* upload pages. My earlier statement that 'only two evidence pages exist' was true ONLY of a blank draft and is now corrected: there are at least TWELVE.

ALL_TWELVE_EVIDENCE_PAGES.note: Verbatim from the sidebar hrefs. Matching is a case-sensitive path-suffix compare, so reproduce the case EXACTLY.
ALL_TWELVE_EVIDENCE_PAGES.CASE_TRAP: /evidence/Alternative-sentencing-or-rehabilitative-programs has a CAPITAL A while every neighbouring slug is lower-case. This is the exact same trap as the I-539's /evidence/form-I-20. A helpfully-lowercased 'alternative-...' would silently match nothing, the walk would log 'page not in descriptor', click past, and the document would never reach USCIS.
ALL_TWELVE_EVIDENCE_PAGES.also_note: /evidence/child-and-spousal-support was seen in the earlier UNCOMMITTED probe (revealed by marital status = Married) but is NOT in this committed list, because marital status was never committed as Married in this run. So the full set is larger still than twelve.

CORRECTION_green_card_slot_exists.wrong: The earlier report said nearly everything (green card, tax transcripts...) must fall to the /evidence/additional-evidence catch-all because no dedicated slot existed.
CORRECTION_green_card_slot_exists.right: /evidence/your-permanent-resident-card IS a dedicated green-card slot — it simply does not appear on a blank draft. The catch-all is still needed for tax transcripts, passports, drivers_license and the rest, but green_card now has a real target.
CORRECTION_green_card_slot_exists.lesson: Never conclude 'no slot exists' from a blank draft. Slot discovery REQUIRES committed answers.

UPLOAD_CONTROL.PNG_IS_NOT_ACCEPTED: The accept list is JPG / JPEG / PDF / TIF / TIFF. There is NO image/png. Our document set includes photos, and the I-539 run uploaded 'photos' successfully — but if any N-400 photo or scan is a PNG, this input will reject it. The backend should either convert or refuse it up front with a clear message, the same way too_big_for_uscis already does for the 12MB cap. Do not discover this on a live filing.
UPLOAD_CONTROL.multiple_true: Batch upload via a single DataTransfer works, consistent with the existing doc-uploader.
UPLOAD_CONTROL.id_note: The input has an id (desktop-drop) and NO name attribute. Any selector keyed on name will miss it.

crime_table.reveal_chain: moralCharacter.crimesAndOffenses.committedCrime=true AND .arrested=true, COMMITTED with Next -> two new pages appear

page2_is_the_table.SOF_1066: This is the online counterpart of PDF Part 9 Item 15, which SOF-1066 wires from applicant.mc_crime_incidents as 5 rows x 6 columns. Online it is EIGHT fields per row because 'place' splits into country/city/state. Worth checking whether mc_crime_incidents holds all eight, or whether the online form needs data the paper table never asked for.

crime_table.why_it_was_invisible_before: Answering both radios Yes WITHOUT committing revealed nothing in-page — the previous pass concluded 'not in-page, needs a commit', which was right. The table is a separate page, not an in-page block.

interpreter_page.note: Mirrors the preparer page field for field, plus gettingStarted.interpreter.language. Same shape as the I-539's interpreter block.

ROW_COMMIT_BUTTONS_ALL_DIFFER.warning: Four distinct labels found across five repeaters. The I-539 was already bitten once by matching advance controls on literal text ('Save Entry' did not match). Do NOT use one regex.
ROW_COMMIT_BUTTONS_ALL_DIFFER.note: A bare 'Add' (the crime table) is the dangerous one — a loose substring matcher for 'add' will match it from other pages, and 'Add an address' also contains 'add'. The I-539 note already records 'Change your client's address' matching a naive 'add' search.

walk_mechanics_learned: Next COMMITS THE WHOLE FORM STATE, not just the current page. Toggles set on an earlier page persisted once any later Next fired.

Most pages advance with Next even when left BLANK — very few fields are hard-required. So a walk can traverse the form without a full seed, but it will not REVEAL the conditional pages, which is the whole point.
A walker MUST wait for render before filling. Without a settle wait it fills and Nexts an empty shell and reports 0 fields — I hit this and pages silently went unanswered (marital-status among them).
Refusing Next on /review-and-submit/* by PATH is the correct guard. The review Next is byte-identical to every other page's, so no text rule can protect it.
STILL_OPEN: The 11 other evidence pages' upload controls — only your-permanent-resident-card was inspected. Assume the same shape, verify before relying on it.
